data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating built-in Urovo barcode scanners on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that integrates Urovo barcode scanners with Android devices. It provides a way to interact with Urovo's built-in scanning hardware and capture barcode data in real-time.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter app for Urovo Android devices with built-in barcode scanners
You need real-time barcode scanning utilizing hardware SDK features
avoid_when: You need to scan barcodes using a standard smartphone camera instead of built-in Urovo hardware
You are targeting iOS or non-Urovo devices
strengths: Real-time barcode scanning using Urovo SDK
Event-based scan results via Flutter EventChannel
weaknesses: Limited to Android and Urovo hardware
No documentation provided for iOS or generic cameras
data.setup_notes: Requires Android devices with built-in Urovo barcode scanning hardware.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need standard camera-based barcode and QR scanning across multiple devices and platforms instead of proprietary Urovo hardware.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you want to use ML Kit for camera-based barcode scanning on standard mobile devices.
